provenance.destination: Litchi publication of self-copy from that source; checks/native-pilot-publication.json
provenance.source: Unmodified LibreOffice QA smoketest.pptx; original producer/save chain unknown

provider_scope: custody-bound distinct source/destination PPTX pair through caller-owned bytes or bounded range adapters
timing_scope: open_source, open_destination, plan, and publication contain only their immediately surrounding public API calls; input loading, adapter construction, sink reservation, diagnostics, oracles, artifact writes, and drops are outside
api_sum_scope: api_sum_ns is the checked sum of open_source_ns, open_destination_ns, plan_ns, and publication_ns; it is not an outer end-to-end timer
allocation_scope: optional operation-scoped global allocator counters; one non-nested region surrounds each API phase and normal binaries omit allocation fields
range_scope: PptxRangeSource logical caller ReadAt counters; request lengths and returned bytes do not describe physical storage or network I/O
oracle_scope: semantic slide readback plus generic ZIP preservation and copied-payload checks; an independent external oracle remains required for full dependency-closure and XML relationship proof

phases.label: baseline
phases.live_owners: caller budgets only; source view, destination editor, adapters, and sink are not opened

phases.label: opened
phases.live_owners: source view, destination editor, caller source adapters, and reserved sink

phases.label: planned
phases.live_owners: source view, destination editor, source-retaining plan, caller source adapters, and sink

phases.label: published
phases.live_owners: source view, source-retaining plan, publication result, caller source adapters, and sink; destination editor consumed

phases.label: drop_result
phases.live_owners: source view, source-retaining plan, caller source adapters, and sink

phases.label: drop_plan
phases.live_owners: source view, caller source adapters, and sink

phases.label: drop_caller_sources
phases.live_owners: sink only; caller source adapters released

phases.label: drop_sink
phases.live_owners: no lifecycle-owned source, plan, result, or sink handle
